player_intent: Use forward-jump legs, torso, and active arm action tracks while retaining equipped weapon aim stability and IK contacts across running jump directions.
acceptance_rule: Normal and multi-directional running jump uses the saved forward clip on thigh-to-toe, shoulder-to-hand, and torso spine tracks, once per airborne entry across takeoff/fall, then releases at landing. Running jump triggers 7.0 m/s impulse for all movement directions (W, A, S, D, diagonals) with sufficient speed. Source-parent rebasing keeps its actual leg orientation under the evaluated base hips while torso tracks authentically articulate the forward jump leap. Weapon aim pitch/yaw and firing readiness remain preserved mid-air with contact tolerances (trigger hand <= 0.015m, support hand <= 0.020m) and bore alignment <= 6.0°. Disabled or missing source leaves the old route intact.

nodes.role: Existing graph filters jump legs, arms, and torso, snapshots the evaluated frame, then rebases thigh roots after final pelvis posture and before hand processing.

must_not_change: torso aim frame and camera/reticle sole aim authority
visual_check: Inspect stationary and forward jumps rear/side: forward-jump legs and articulating arm action, weapon aim tracked to reticle without broken wrist IK, continuous takeoff-to-fall playhead and normal landing.

system_delta.reason: Reuse verified imported forward-jump clip through existing graph on leg and arm tracks while preserving presentation IK and camera aim authority.

candidate.system: Filtered continuous forward-jump leg and arm source
